D HH/HL 0.45% under the 20-day high and H1 above EMA9 at 70.4% of range show trend, not decisive volume. I accept flow is advisory only; R4 carries the case.

In CAN SLIM it is a named climax signal: entry 116.84 against ma200 67.78 is over 70% above the 200-day, and C24 sells into that (R7, a hold-firm rule). W HH/HL 1.7% under the 20-wk high is what a climax run looks like; no base under it (coil warn).
